seo_description: Holi 2027 is on 22 March. The best white cotton kurtas and tunics for Holi, what to wear for Holi parties in the USA and UK, and how to avoid stains.
body:
## Quick answer

Holi 2027 is on **Monday, 22 March** (Holika Dahan the evening before). The classic Holi outfit is a **white or off-white cotton kurta** – white makes the colours pop in photos. Choose **breathable, washable cotton** you do not mind staining, wear full sleeves and pants for skin protection, and oil your hair and skin before playing. For Holi parties in the USA and UK, which are often on the weekend after, order by **6 March**.

## Why white for Holi?

White shows every colour of gulal, so your photos look bright and joyful. It also signals that you are ready to play. Off-white, cream and very light pastels work just as well.

## Best Holi outfits

| Outfit | Why it works | Tip |
|---|---|---|
| White/off-white cotton kurta + pants | Classic look, full coverage | Keep the dupatta at home or tie it tightly |
| Light block-print cotton tunic + white jeans | Casual Indo-Western | Great for park and campus Holi events |
| Grey or pastel cotton kurta set | Hides stains better after the party | Good if you want to wear it again |
| Old white kurta + new dupatta | Budget option | Save your best outfit for the evening |

## How to protect your skin, hair and clothes

1. **Oil your hair and skin** (coconut or mustard oil) before playing – colour washes off more easily.
2. **Full sleeves and long pants** protect skin from strong colours.
3. **Choose cotton, not silk or synthetic** – cotton is cool and washes better.
4. **Wear sunglasses** to protect your eyes.
5. **Wash in cold water first**, separately, and soak with a little salt or vinegar to stop colour spreading.

## Holi parties in the USA, UK and Canada

Many temples, universities and community groups hold Holi on the nearest weekend, often outdoors and sometimes still chilly in March. Add a light white shrug or a thin thermal layer underneath. For non-Indian guests, a simple white kurta or white tunic with jeans is perfect – hosts love it.

## Frequently asked questions

**When is Holi in 2027?**
Holi is on Monday, 22 March 2027, with Holika Dahan on the evening of 21 March. Many celebrations abroad are on the weekend after.

**What colour should I wear for Holi?**
White or off-white is traditional because it shows the colours beautifully.

**What fabric is best for Holi?**
Breathable, washable cotton. Avoid silk and delicate embroidery.

**How do I stop Holi colour from staining?**
Oil your skin and hair first, wear full sleeves, and wash clothes separately in cold water.
